invariants.rationale: The method returns an object created by execute(), which should never return null.
If execution has reached a return, then records is expected to be an initialized List (possibly empty), never null or negative-sized.
context is dereferenced/cast in the body and therefore must be non-null at the return point.
The commit instant time is typically required and should be non-empty for transactional operations.
bulkInsertPartitioner is passed into another object and must be non-null (even if it may represent Option.empty()).
